keys.label: Dock apps
keys.description: The dock row, in order; missing apps are skipped

keys.label: Fill dock
keys.description: Fill the dock slots `dock_apps` leaves free with the first grid apps (true by default); false leaves them empty

keys.label: Hidden apps
keys.description: Never shown as tiles

keys.label: Live tv package
keys.description: The Live TV app and, if it has no leanback entry, the action to start it with

keys.label: Live tv action
keys.description: The Live TV app and, if it has no leanback entry, the action to start it with

keys.label: Live tv input id
keys.description: Exact system tuner for the Inputs menu's Live TV row; opens its channel collection. Empty keeps automatic selection. Missing input or unsupported collection falls back to the app's normal launch. [HAAM satellite example](../docs/devices/haam-r4.md)

keys.label: Source panel service
keys.description: The TV's own source panel, for sets with no TvInputManager: a service, or an activity (BYINTEK U4). Without a Live TV app, the Inputs pill opens it directly

keys.label: Source panel action
keys.description: The TV's own source panel, for sets with no TvInputManager: a service, or an activity (BYINTEK U4). Without a Live TV app, the Inputs pill opens it directly

keys.label: Source panel extra
keys.description: One int extra sent with the source panel (Coocaa OS: `control_center_command=100`)

keys.label: Coocaa sources
keys.description: Coocaa OS (Skyworth, China): list the sources from `com.skyworth.tv` in the Inputs menu, ahead of the source panel

keys.label: Launch actions
keys.description: Tiles and `top_bar_apps` buttons that open a screen of the app instead of its start screen; an action that no longer resolves opens the app normally (MagentaTV's guide: `com.telekom.onetv.tv.pl=com.telekom.onetv.tv.pl.action.PROGRAM_GUIDE`)

keys.label: App labels
keys.description: A tile's name instead of the app's own (MagentaTV as `com.telekom.onetv.tv.pl=TV`)

keys.label: App banners
keys.description: A tile's artwork from a `banner_*` drawable bundled with the launcher (`banner_tv`: magenta with the Live TV glyph)

keys.label: Input action
keys.description: Action sent with an HDMI/AV row's channel URI when nothing handles the standard `VIEW` (XGIMI: `com.xgimi.action.hdmiPlayer`). Only a handler-less set gets here; any app that claims the channel MIME type takes the row instead, so check with `query-activities` ([#805](https://github.com/Gathin23/cleanyourtv/issues/805))

keys.label: Input uri scheme
keys.description: Scheme an HDMI/AV row's passthrough URI is sent with instead of `content://`, with no MIME type (YaOS: `live-tv`, which its source player answers)

keys.label: Input sources
keys.description: Vendor source numbers for the Inputs menu, `HW<n>=<number>` by the input id's last part; a mapped input opens by sending `input_action` with the number as the int extra `input`, and `HW<n>=-` leaves a port the set doesn't have out of the menu. Xiaomi/Redmi China firmware: [redmi-mitv-mftp0](../examples/redmi-mitv-mftp0/)

keys.label: Columns
keys.description: Tiles per row; tiles shrink to fit from 5 up

keys.label: Rows below dock
keys.description: Grid rows left visible under the dock; tiles shrink if the dock, its title and that many rows would not fit the screen height

keys.label: Dock title
keys.description: The focused dock app's name in large type above the dock (`true`); `false` keeps only the glow

keys.label: Dock row
keys.description: The dock as its own row with a band (`true`); `false` makes the dock apps the first tiles of one plain grid

keys.label: Reorder button
keys.description: A reorder button in the top bar (`false` by default); reordering is always in the Settings button's long-press menu

keys.label: Show network pill
keys.description: The Wi-Fi/Ethernet pill in the top bar (`true` by default); `false` hides it

keys.label: Top bar apps
keys.description: Apps shown as round buttons with their own logo in the top bar, left of the network pill; they leave the grid

keys.label: Show inputs pill
keys.description: The Inputs pill in the top bar, shown when the TV has inputs (`true` by default); `false` hides it, and with `top_menu` it also leaves Inputs out of the gear's menu (streamers with no HDMI input, such as the Chromecast with Google TV); what the remote's Input button does is unchanged

keys.label: Icon only buttons
keys.description: Wi-Fi and Settings as round icon buttons; Inputs keeps its label (`false` by default)

keys.label: Icon only inputs
keys.description: The Inputs pill as a round icon button too, its label kept as the TalkBack description (`false` by default). Works with or without `icon_only_buttons`

keys.label: Top menu
keys.description: Inputs, Wi-Fi and Settings folded into one round gear, centred on the header: OK drops a menu with the three plus Reorder apps, hold OK keeps the launcher menu (`false` by default)

keys.label: Launcher settings button
keys.description: Make the header Settings action open Launcher settings directly with a matching 22dp home icon; also changes the Settings row when `top_menu` is on. Hold OK keeps module-card and ordering tools. The settings page includes Reorder apps and TV settings (`false` by default)

keys.label: Wifi status color
keys.description: The Wi-Fi pill's icon green while the TV is online, white while it is not (`false` by default)

keys.label: Wifi status warnings
keys.description: With `wifi_status_color`, the icon orange while connected without internet (a captive portal waiting for its login page) and red while offline, instead of white (`false` by default)

keys.label: Wifi label width
keys.description: With `icon_only_buttons`, keep the network name on the Wi-Fi pill up to this width in dp, cut with an ellipsis; 0 leaves only the icon

keys.label: Library button
keys.description: The app library as a round button in the top bar, beside Settings; needs `app_library`. Closing the library returns to it

keys.label: Show library pill
keys.description: The App library pill after the last Home row (`true` by default); `false` hides it while `library_button` is on, so the top-bar button stays the way in and Down from the last row stays put, as with `app_library` off

keys.label: Always show names
keys.description: Names under every tile, dimmed until focused, the dock included (its band grows to hold them); `false` by default shows only the focused tile's name

keys.label: Wallpaper true color
keys.description: Decode wallpapers in 32-bit colour (8 MB at 1080p) instead of RGB_565 (4 MB), which bands dark gradients such as a night sky; for TVs with 2 GB or more (`false` by default)

keys.label: App library
keys.description: An App library pill after the last Home row: every installed app, add one to Home or take it off (`false` by default). The choices stay on the TV when a theme is pushed or reset; see [docs/app-library.md](../docs/app-library.md)

keys.label: Uniform tiles
keys.description: Each app tile is its icon on a card tinted from that icon, with the name only under the focused tile, instead of the app's own banner (`false` by default)

keys.label: App library selection
keys.description: OK toggles Home checkmarks in the library; checked apps first, both groups alphabetized. Hiding keeps focus on the adjacent next app (previous at the end). Requires `app_library`; `false` preserves the standard open/long-press behavior

keys.label: Library ok opens
keys.description: OK opens every app in the library, not only the ones on Home, for a library that holds the apps `hidden_apps` keeps off Home; holding OK still offers Add to Home, and cards drop their "Add to Home" line. Requires `app_library`; `app_library_selection` wins when both are on; `false` by default

keys.label: Library apps
keys.description: Packages pre-seeded into the App library's "added" set at startup (config.xml `library_apps`, or a theme's `config.json`). They show on Home as if the owner had added them in the App library UI, and stay removable there (a removed one stays hidden); empty (off) by default

keys.label: Shamsi date
keys.description: Show the Solar Hijri date above the Gregorian one

keys.label: Lunar date
keys.description: Show the lunisolar date under the Gregorian one, e.g. `LUNAR 13/9 · YEAR OF THE HORSE`, or `13/9 ÂM LỊCH · BÍNH NGỌ` in Vietnamese; a leap month is marked. Off by default

keys.label: Lunar utc offset
keys.description: Hours east of UTC the lunar calendar is computed for: `7` is the Vietnamese calendar, `8` the Chinese one; they differ by a day now and then (and by a month in 1985). Unset: 7 when the TV is in Vietnamese, 8 otherwise

keys.label: Date below clock
keys.description: The date (with the Shamsi and lunar lines) on its own line under the clock instead of beside it, for a top bar whose pills leave the date too little room (`false` by default)

keys.label: Locale
keys.description: The language the launcher shows itself in, as a language tag (`"vi"`, `"pt-BR"`), instead of the TV's: for firmware with no menu entry for a language the launcher speaks (a China-market Xiaomi offers Chinese and English only). Empty by default, which follows the TV

keys.label: Greeting name
keys.description: A name after the greeting, e.g. `"Mr. Trịnh"` for GOOD MORNING, MR. TRỊNH; empty for the greeting alone

keys.label: Show greeting
keys.description: The greeting above the clock (`true` by default); `false` hides it

keys.label: Header white
keys.description: The date and the line between the clock and the date in the clock's full white instead of dimmed (`false` by default)

keys.label: Module cards
keys.description: Look for module cards and ask about them (`true`); `false` turns the feature off

keys.label: Reduced motion
keys.description: Calmer motion for weak GPUs: the highlight slides without bouncing and settles within 5 frames, every animation lasts 90 ms or less, names, the top shelf, the glow and the highlight appear instead of fading, and there is no tile entrance (`false` by default)

keys.label: Boot to live tv
keys.description: Open the Live TV app (`live_tv_package`) on the first Home after the TV starts, once per boot

keys.label: Open on start choice
keys.description: `true` adds an **Open on start** row to Launcher settings: pick an app on the TV, and the first Home after each boot opens it instead (once per boot; `boot_to_live_tv` wins when both are set; an app that is gone or disabled leaves Home on screen). Off by default

keys.label: Focus overshoot
keys.description: The highlight and the focused tile swing past their target before settling (`true` by default); `false` glides straight there with smooth scrolling

keys.label: Vpn app
keys.description: App the network pill opens when a VPN is configured; also shows a red "VPN off" badge while no VPN is up

keys.label: Vpn pill
keys.description: The VPN as its own pill after the network pill instead of a badge inside it: solid green while a VPN is up, solid red "VPN off" while none is and `vpn_app` is installed, hidden otherwise. Pressing it opens `vpn_app` (without it, the App library, or VPN settings with `app_library` off); it keeps its label with `icon_only_buttons`; the network pill then opens Wi-Fi settings. Ignored with `top_menu`. A VPN app's kill switch holds a VPN up while the app says disconnected, so the pill stays green then (`false` by default)

keys.label: Animations
keys.description: Basic focus, glass, title and tile entrance motion; true by default

keys.label: Advanced effects
keys.description: Optional lifted tile, icon zoom, smooth ambient colour and app opening effects; false by default

keys.label: Show home settings shortcut
keys.description: Keep the optional Default-home tile visible when the TV has a home picker; false by default

keys.label: Show stats
keys.description: One line under the clock with CPU, free memory and free storage. Off unless set

keys.label: Handle view inputs
keys.description: Answer the system input switcher (`VIEW_INPUTS`, what the remote's Input button becomes) with the Inputs menu, for sets whose stock launcher was its only handler (Hisense huangshan); `false` by default so a TV with its own input picker never gets a chooser

keys.label: Background color
keys.description: Colour behind everything; black by default

keys.label: Sky intensity
keys.description: Time-of-day backdrop: a dark gradient that follows the clock, 0 hides it (default)

keys.label: Wallpaper
keys.description: Show the theme's picture, `wallpaper.jpg` or its `wallpapers/` collection (`true`), or draw neither (`false`)

keys.label: Wallpaper rotation minutes
keys.description: Rotate images in the theme's `wallpapers/` folder at this interval; 0 keeps the single-image behaviour. A negative or non-numeric value is ignored, and 0 means "no rotation", not "every minute"

keys.label: Wallpaper order
keys.description: How a collection advances. `shuffle` (the default, and what launchers did before this key existed) avoids repeating the current picture; `sequential` walks the folder in filename order and wraps at the end. An unknown value falls back to `shuffle`

keys.label: Wallpaper dim
keys.description: Black overlay over wallpaper images, in percent; 0 by default and no shade view at all

keys.label: Dock opacity
keys.description: Opacity of the dock's band, in percent, so a wallpaper shows through it; 100 by default (the cinematic shelf keeps its own translucent band). Launcher settings on the TV offers 100, 70, 50 or 30, which wins until the next theme push or Follow theme

keys.label: Wallpaper captions
keys.description: With a rotating collection, the shown picture's name under the top-right buttons, from `wallpapers/captions.txt` (`001.jpg<TAB>Dusk over the peaks`, one per line); a picture without a line shows no name (`false` by default)

keys.label: Wallpaper moods
keys.description: A rotating collection grouped by time of day: `{"morning": [...], "evening": [...], "night": [...]}` with file names from `wallpapers/`. Morning runs from sunrise to noon, evening until half an hour after sunset, night the rest, with the sun at config.xml's `latitude` and `longitude` (07:00 and 18:30 without them); a missing group rotates through every picture. Unset by default

keys.label: Tile menu
keys.description: Hold OK or press the remote's Menu key on a tile to open a small menu: Move, Remove from Home (with `app_library`) and App info. `false` (the default) keeps holding OK as a shortcut to the app's App info page and leaves Menu unchanged

keys.label: Festival
keys.description: Turns on a festive skin: the network pill becomes a diya whose flame follows the connection, Inputs a temple bell, Settings a marigold, and the first Home of the day gets a petal shower. `dussehra` and `diwali` have built-in greetings

keys.label: Festival until
keys.description: Last day the festive skin shows; it switches itself off after that. A malformed date turns it off

keys.label: Greeting
keys.description: Replaces the time-of-day greeting while the festive skin is on

keys.label: Accent color
keys.description: Colour of the focus glow while the festive skin is on; diya gold if not set

keys.label: Settings key keycodes
keys.description: Remote buttons that open Settings, for `HomeKeyService` (TCL Google TV gear: `[83]`)

keys.label: Settings key panel
keys.description: Those buttons open a small quick settings panel (TV settings, Display, Network, Apps, Launcher settings) instead of the TV's Settings

keys.label: Restore key services
keys.description: After a force stop of the launcher, Home puts the remote's accessibility helpers (`HomeKeyService`, `InputKeyService`) back on the enabled list; needs `RESTORE_KEY_SERVICES=1` at install. Off by default

keys.label: Input key keycodes
keys.description: More remote buttons that open the input switcher, for `InputKeyService` (`KEYCODE_TV` and `KEYCODE_TV_INPUT` always do)

keys.label: App keys
keys.description: Remote buttons that open an app, as `"190:com.google.android.youtube.tv"` or `"KEYCODE_BUTTON_3:com.google.android.youtube.tv"`, or by scancode as `"scan:490:com.wbd.hbomax"` for remotes that share one keycode between app buttons (Sony BRAVIA), for `InputKeyService` or `HomeKeyService`. `"input:<input id>"` in place of the package switches to a TV input instead, e.g. `"scan:227:input:com.tcl.tvinput/.passthroughinput.TvPassThroughService/HW1413744640"` for an HDMI port (ids from `dumpsys tv_input`). `"inputs"` in place of the package opens the Inputs menu, for a remote whose source button send

keys.label: Key filter
keys.description: `false` makes the key helpers stop filtering keys while staying enabled. Use it on firmware where any key-filtering accessibility service breaks long-press repeat (TCL Google TV on Android 12): the remote buttons above stop working, and volume repeat comes back

keys.label: Gamepad passthrough
keys.description: `true` makes the key helpers stop filtering keys while a game controller is connected, so games see its buttons (Steam Link with an Xbox controller, Moonlight with two controllers); the remote buttons above do nothing until it disconnects. Needs `key_filter` on. A voice remote that reports a joystick does not count. Off by default

keys.label: Consume volume keys
keys.description: `true` makes the key helpers swallow Volume Up/Down and repeat a held one themselves (after 500 ms, every 60 ms). Use it on firmware that applies a volume key both before the helper and when the helper hands it back, so one tap moves two steps (TCL G03 / BeyondTV4, Android 11, #1100). Needs `key_filter` on. Off by default

keys.label: Stock home redirect
keys.description: Stock launcher package; if the firmware turns it back on (XGIMI), its home screen is sent straight back here (`HOME_KEY_SERVICE=1`)

keys.label: Power on home
keys.description: For firmware that opens the Live TV app (`live_tv_package`) by itself at every power-on (Changhong / Homwee): until the first key press after boot or screen-on, that Live TV window is sent back to Home (`HOME_KEY_SERVICE=1`). Ignored with `boot_to_live_tv`, or with Live TV as the Open on start app. Off by default

keys.label: Home long press home
keys.description: Every Home press opens Home, a held one too. Android turns a Home press held past 400 ms into ALL_APPS for the system-image launcher, which nothing answers once the stock launcher is disabled, so a firm press on a slow remote did nothing (Philips TPM191E, Android 12, where `long_press_timeout` does not move that limit). Needs `key_filter` (`HOME_KEY_SERVICE=1`), so held keys such as Volume Up/Down stop repeating, confirmed on that Philips; single presses still step. Off by default

keys.label: Power on home always
keys.description: Home at every power-on, whatever the TV put in front: the last HDMI input, Live TV or an app, for TVs that come back to the last source (Philips). Unlike `power_on_home`, it does not wait for a window to show: the Home screen comes up about a second after the screen turns on (`HOME_KEY_SERVICE=1`). A key pressed before that wins. Ignored with `boot_to_live_tv`, or with an Open on start app. Off by default

keys.label: Race calendar
keys.description: F1 race-weekend mode: from 12 hours before a weekend's first session until 4 hours after the race starts, a panel under the clock shows the next session with a countdown (or the live one) and the weekend's session times in the TV's time zone. Write it with `tools/race_calendar.py <theme folder>`, which fetches the season from the free Jolpica API; the launcher itself never goes online

keys.label: Home idle clock minutes
keys.description: Minutes Home may sit untouched before it shows the clock screensaver (a thin clock and date drifting over a slow glow, as the system "Clock" screensaver does). Any key returns to Home. It starts only from Home, never over Live TV or an app; 0 is off (default)

keys.label: Clock wallpaper
keys.description: The clock screensaver over Home's wallpaper instead of black with a coloured glow; the clock still moves every minute (`false` by default)

keys.label: Clock wallpaper dim
keys.description: How dark that wallpaper is behind the clock, in percent (50 by default)

keys.label: Clock glow
keys.description: The clock screensaver's coloured glow (`true` by default); `false` leaves the moving clock on plain black, e.g. for an OLED

keys.label: Glow style
keys.description: Shape of the glow behind the focused app, in its colour: `radial` (default) or `horizon`, the colour washing down from the top edge to black; the cinematic shelf keeps its own

keys.label: Glass style
keys.description: Look of the focus highlight: `glass` (default: a translucent slab with a bright top sheen, a crisp rim and a faint outer glow), `rim` (the crisp rim alone, no sheen, fill or glow, for a quiet focus over a wallpaper) or `halo` (the rim with a lighter outer glow)

keys.label: Cinematic home
keys.description: Cinematic top shelf: the focused dock app's artwork, softened, fills the top of the screen in its colour, with a larger name, "Last opened" (apps opened from Home), dock position dots, a focus glow in the app's colour and a translucent dock band; off by default

keys.label: Cinematic dots
keys.description: With `cinematic_home`, the dock position dots under the app's name (`true` by default); `false` leaves them out

keys.label: Cinematic white focus
keys.description: With `cinematic_home`, the focus highlight stays white on the dock instead of taking the focused app's colour (`false` by default); `app_glow` still colours every tile

keys.label: Cinematic scrim
keys.description: With `cinematic_home`, the strength of the dark scrim behind the shelf's name (`100` by default); lower lets a wallpaper show through

keys.label: Cinematic art
keys.description: With `cinematic_home`, the opacity of the focused app's softened artwork (`50` by default); `0` leaves the wallpaper uncovered

keys.label: Dock even padding
keys.description: The dock band's padding equals the gap between its tiles on all four sides, as far as the grid's edges leave room (`false` by default)

keys.label: Dock glass
keys.description: The dock band as light frosted glass like the top bar's pills (`false` by default); suits `sky_intensity` or a wallpaper, where the solid band reads as a dark slab

keys.label: Dock band
keys.description: Draw the dock band and its edge (`true` by default); `false` leaves the tiles floating on the wallpaper with no band, border or dark slab

keys.label: Single row
keys.description: Every app in the dock's row, the dock apps first, scrolling sideways; no grid below (`false` by default; needs `dock_row`)

keys.label: Dock band all
keys.description: With `single_row`, the band runs behind every app in the row, not only the dock apps (`false` by default)

keys.label: Ambient glow
keys.description: The glow behind the dock in the focused app's colour (`true` by default); `false` keeps only `background_color` or the wallpaper, e.g. for a calm photo background

keys.label: App glow
keys.description: The focus highlight glows in the focused app's colour on every tile, as `cinematic_home` does for the dock (`false` by default)

keys.label: Fade rows
keys.description: The rows fade out as they scroll up under the clock instead of being cut off at a hard line; the wallpaper or sky shows through. The grid then draws into a hardware layer (about 6 MB of graphics memory at 1080p) (`false` by default)
